queries:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(E.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG, AVG(E.ANA) AS avg_ANA
  FROM Examination E
  INNER JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
  GROUP BY P.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, avg_aCL_IgG, avg_ANA,
       avg_ANA / ((SELECT SUM(avg_ANA) FROM s) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)) AS ana_ratio
FROM s;

SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.ANA) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(e2.ANA) FROM Examination e2 INNER JOIN Patient p2 ON e2.ID = p2.ID) AS ratio
FROM Examination e
INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.SEX
SELECT AVG(`aCL IgG`), AVG(ANA) FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL AND ANA IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(avg_ana)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(E.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination E
    JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(P.SEX, ''), 'UNKNOWN')
);

SELECT P.SEX, AVG(E.ANA) AS avg_ana, AVG(AVG(E.ANA)) OVER () AS mean_of_sex_avgs
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX IS NOT NULL AND P.SEX <> ''
GROUP BY P.SEX
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient;
